provenance_note: risk_score/denial_prob/annual_penalty are MODELED heuristics informed by public carrier guidelines, NAIC bulletins, and industry loss data — NOT actuarial tables. Replace with carrier underwriting manuals for binding figures. Patterns are regex (applied case-insensitively with alternation).

data.description: Polybutylene plumbing - known failure risk, most carriers will deny coverage
data.source_note: InterNACHI guidance; carrier denial practice widely documented

data.description: Knob-and-tube wiring - fire hazard, most carriers require full rewiring
data.source_note: NFPA guidance; carrier non-renewal practice documented in state DOI bulletins

data.description: Federal Pacific panel - active class action, 94% denial probability
data.source_note: CPSC recall history; UL and carrier bulletins on Stab-Lok failure rates

data.description: Zinsco panel - known breaker welding/failure under overload
data.source_note: InterNACHI hazard profile; carrier surcharge practice

data.description: Aluminum branch wiring - fire/overheating risk at connections
data.source_note: CPSC consumer guidance; COPAL/AlumiConn remediation standard

data.description: Asbestos materials - specialized abatement required by law
data.source_note: EPA AHERA/RRP rules; abatement cost ranges from state health depts

data.description: Lead-based paint - EPA RRP rule compliance required
data.source_note: EPA RRP rule; HUD lead-safe work practice standards

data.description: Active mold growth - health hazard, carrier may exclude related claims
data.source_note: EPA mold remediation guidance; carrier exclusion practice post-2000 policies

data.description: Aging roof (12+ years) - many carriers require certification or will non-renew
data.source_note: Insurance Information Institute; state DOI roofing-billing laws (FL TX NC)

data.description: Active water intrusion - immediate risk of structural damage and mold
data.source_note: Insurance Information Institute; sudden-vs-continuing damage doctrine

data.description: Foundation/structural issues - major liability, often excluded from coverage
data.source_note: III foundational-exclusion overview; state adjuster manuals

data.description: Radon above 4.0 pCi/L - mitigation system required for occupancy
data.source_note: EPA action level 4.0 pCi/L; state disclosure statutes

data.description: Termite/WDI - structural wood damage, often excluded from homeowner policies
data.source_note: III; state WDI inspection laws (termite bonds)

data.description: Septic system - potential failure, replacement is major expense
data.source_note: EPA septic systems overview; state replacement cost surveys

data.description: Private well - water quality risk, no municipal backup
data.source_note: EPA private well guidance; state health dept testing standards
